dedupe_keys.name: european bidding zone hydropower generation and ramping constraints

description: This Zenodo dataset converts ENTSO-E Transparency Platform generation histories into operational bounds for hydropower in aggregated energy models. The article states that 2020–2024 generation by pumped storage, reservoir and run-of-river or pondage was processed across forty-four European bidding zones. The public CC BY 4.0 release lists HydropowerConstraints.xlsx and PondageVolume.xlsx, including weekly series of hourly minimum and maximum generation and hourly ramp-rate limits. These are inferred system-level operating constraints, not plant-by-plant turbine ratings or a complete hydrological runoff model. Bidding-zone aggregation, reporting gaps and observed-history assumptions are limitations when exploring future extreme droughts or storage strategies. A reviewer-assessed use is constraining dispatch flexibility in large-scale electricity simulations. model-pypsa and data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower are related energy-model and hydropower resources, but no direct importer or comparative run was verified. No workbook was downloaded.
